disciplinary_grounds.description: Denying access to department officers/employees or offering resistance to inspections
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful to deny such access to the officers and employees of the department or to offer any resistance to, thwart, or hinder such officers and employees by misrepresentation or by concealing facts or conditions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to correct insanitary conditions after notice by the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any operator or owner of such apiary, honey house, building, or container failing to obey such notice shall be in violation of the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly keeping bees affected with disease, parasites, or pests without proper treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person knowingly to keep in his or her possession, without proper treatment, any colony of bees affected with any bee diseases, parasites, or pests

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exposing diseased or parasitized colony or infected equipment so flying bees may have access
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or to expose any diseased or parasitized colony or infected hive or bee equipment so that flying bees may have access to them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report contagious or infectious diseases, parasites, or pests to the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who knows that bees owned or controlled by him or her are affected with contagious or infectious diseases, parasites, or pests shall at once report such fact to the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Removing colony, honey, or bee equipment from a quarantined apiary without a special written permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whenever American foulbrood is found in the apiary, no colony, honey, or bee equipment of any kind shall be removed from the apiary unless under special written permit issued by the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a certificate issued by the department after it has been revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of such certificate issued by the department after it has been revoked and before such revocation has been withdrawn by the department shall be unlawful

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the Nebraska Apiary Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person violating any of the provisions of the Nebraska Apiary Act shall be guilty of a Class III misdemeanor.

definition_quote.value: Beekeeping shall mean the moving, raising, and producing of bees, beeswax, and honey which is an agricultural pursuit
definition_quote.quote: Beekeeping shall mean the moving, raising, and producing of bees, beeswax, and honey which is an agricultural pursuit

registration_required.quote: The department is authorized to enforce the Nebraska Apiary Act.

apiary_identification_required.quote: Each apiary not located at the owner's or operator's place of residence shall have posted in a conspicuous place the name and address of the owner.

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: apiaries having bees in hives without movable frames or any colonies of bees or shipments of used bee equipment which entered this state illegally are declared to be a public nuisance

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: Infected shipments, apiaries in which the existing disease, parasite, or pest cannot be successfully treated, apiaries which are affected by a disease, parasite, or pest amenable to treatment but which have not been treated as provided in section 81-2,168, and apiaries having bees in hives without movable frames or any colonies of bees or shipments of used bee equipment which entered this state illegally are declared to be a public nuisance and menace to the community

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: Pest shall mean any harmful subspecies of the honeybee Apis mellifera, including, but not limited to, Apis mellifera scutellata.

regulated_diseases.quote: Disease shall mean American foulbrood, European foulbrood, chalkbrood, sacbrood, paralysis, or any other abnormal condition of egg, larva, pupa, or adult stages of bees

disease_reporting_required.quote: Any person who knows that bees owned or controlled by him or her are affected with contagious or infectious diseases, parasites, or pests shall at once report such fact to the department

quarantine_authority.quote: When it has been determined that contagious or infectious diseases, parasites, or pests have been found in an apiary, such apiary may be quarantined by the department until released by the department.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: the officers and employees of the department may at all reasonable times enter upon any public or private premises for the purpose of inspection

beekeeping_classified_as_agricultural_pr.quote: Beekeeping shall mean the moving, raising, and producing of bees, beeswax, and honey which is an agricultural pursuit

inspection_fee_charged.quote: upon payment of the certificate fee provided for in section 81-2,174
